# Corezoid Research

> Research corpus of Alexander Vityaz (Corezoid Inc., ORCID 0009-0006-0489-7881): the actor model, Actor Graphs, active transaction graphs, organisational cybernetics (Conant–Ashby), the computable theory of the firm, the digital twin of an organisation, and the ontology of transition. Papers carry version DOIs (Zenodo or ResearchGate); interviews and press releases are primary sources outside the citation graph. Text license CC BY 4.0.

- [Full catalogue with abstracts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/skills/corezoid-research/references/index.md)
- [Glossary of terms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/skills/corezoid-research/references/glossary.md)
- [Publishing and citation rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/PUBLISHING.md)

## Papers

- [Active Transaction Graphs: A Formal Framework for Transactional Interactive Systems](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-active-transaction-graphs/paper.md): We introduce Active Transaction Graphs (ATGs), a formal framework for interactive systems in which persistent state, mediated interaction, execution traceability, and accounting consequences must be modeled simultaneously. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20747873
- [Actor Graphs: Triple-Identity Accountable Mediation and Coinductive Disclosure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-actor-graphs/paper.pdf): This paper defines an **Actor Graph (AG)** as a named mathematical object with pluggable execution semantics. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21995981
- [Beyond Programming Languages](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-beyond-programming-languages/paper.md): Programming languages historically combined two functions: making human intent intelligible and making machine execution precise. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21458098
- [The Compact Company: An Actor-Graph Theory of the Firm in the LLM Era](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-compact-company/paper.md): This paper introduces the **Compact Company** as a distinct category in organizational theory. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21774758
- [Company Brain: The Architecture of General Company Intelligence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-company-brain/paper.md): This paper proposes Company Brain—an architectural framework for the cognitive organ of an enterprise, emerging when a digital core, a digital twin, meta-regulation, and human goal-setting converge into a single regulatory loop. DOI 10.13140/RG.2.2.28274.88007
- [The Computable Boundary of the Firm: Information Conditions for Viability and the Transactional Architecture of the Digital Twin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-computable-boundary-of-the-firm/paper.md): In the practice of digital twins of organizations (DTOs), the boundary of the enterprise is often not instantiated as an independent object of the control model. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20745927
- [How to Become a Smart Company](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-how-to-become-a-smart-company/paper.md): Artificial intelligence deployed within a fragmented enterprise architecture amplifies fragmentation accumulated across software, integrations, processes, vendor dependencies, and organisational routines. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21792643
- [Management Debt—Part I: Concept, Metrics, and Principles for Attributing Materialised Debts to Actor Accounts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-management-debt-part-i/paper.md): This article develops a formal framework for conceptualising and accounting for management debt as a distinct accounting object. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21069692
- [Metaunderstanding: Recursive Compression, Tag Accounts, and Actor Graphs as the Next Layer of Mind in the Age of AI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-metaunderstanding/paper.md): The mind is not a library but a compressor-regulator. DOI none yet (ResearchGate 403758098)
- [On the Necessity of Noise Suppression for Minimal Good Regulators: Factorization Theorems and a Closure Conjecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-noise-suppression-minimal-good-regulators/paper.md): We prove a factorization necessity result: any *minimal* good regulator (i.e., capacity-efficient in the sense of not expending control capacity on goal-irrelevant distinctions) must factorize through a noise-suppressing projection onto a pragmatic signal space. DOI 10.13140/RG.2.2.33143.07843
- [Ontology of Transition: Causal Order, External Time, and the Thermodynamics of Physical Clock Records](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-ontology-of-transition/volume.pdf): This volume develops Ontology of Transition, a framework in which transition rather than the static thing is the primitive unit of description. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21380580
- [A Phase Model of Enterprise Evolution: From Fragmentation to the Autonomous Enterprise](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-phase-model-of-enterprise-evolution/paper.md): This paper presents a four-phase model of enterprise evolution grounded in two results from regulation theory: the Conant–Ashby good regulator theorem and the factorisation necessity theorem for minimal good regulators. DOI 10.13140/RG.2.2.24883.39207
- [Quantum Learning: From Educational Programs to Managing Changes in Human Capability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-quantum-learning/paper.md): The modern educational system is organized around large, preassembled units: the course, discipline, semester, program, qualification, and degree. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21704460
- [Regulatory Quality of Asymptotic Models: A Quantitative Framework with Arithmetic Benchmark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-regulatory-quality-asymptotic-models/paper.md): We introduce a quantitative framework for measuring how well an asymptotic model regulates a finite system, grounded in the Conant–Ashby Good Regulator Theorem. DOI 10.13140/RG.2.2.31082.79042
- [What Is Work: The Law of Information Conservation and the AI Productivity Paradox in High-Context Knowledge Work](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-what-is-work/paper.md): The paper asks what work is from an informational point of view, and whether AI actually reduces its volume. DOI none yet (ResearchGate 403936327)
- [Ontology of Transition—Part I: Causal Order of Events, Internal and External Clocks, Thermodynamics, and Information-Theoretic Distinguishability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-ontology-of-transition/part-i/paper.md): This article takes transition rather than thing as the primary unit of ontological description. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21471785
- [Ontology of Transition — Part II: The Unidentifiable Clock: Reconstruction Limits and Gauge Freedom of External Time under Lossy Delivery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-ontology-of-transition/part-ii/paper.md): This is Part II of a series. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21472271
- [Ontology of Transition — Part III: The Thermodynamic Price of External Time: Rate–Distortion Bounds for Physical Clock Records](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/research/main/papers/2026-ontology-of-transition/part-iii/paper.md): This article is Part III of the three-part scientific work *Ontology of Transition*. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21473025
